name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: In Old Town, Elling Trias sends you after a name tied to the missing diplomat’s case. Dashel Stonefist may know more about suspicious papers, and the search leads into Stormwind’s rough streets.

sections.title: A Lead in Old Town
sections.body: Elling Trias recalls Dashel Stonefist, known as Fist, among the names tied to the coded notes and leads. A rough street fighter, Stonefist keeps to the cramped alleys of Old Town. Finding him takes the search from Stormwind Keep’s grand halls into the city’s criminal circles.

sections.title: Persuasion by the Fist
sections.body: Elling Trias warns that Dashel Stonefist will not speak freely to curious strangers, especially when treason and kidnappings are involved. If questions fail, Trias says force will have to speak. Stonefist treats the alleyways as his domain. He resents outsiders probing matters that could cost him his livelihood or his neck.

faq.answer: Dashel Stonefist is a notorious brawler who frequents the central alleys of Stormwind’s Old Town. Trias links him to incriminating papers found during the search for the missing diplomat.

faq.q: Where can I find Dashel Stonefist?
faq.answer: Dashel Stonefist lingers outdoors in the alleys near the center of Old Town, away from its main streets.

faq.q: Why is Elling Trias sending me after him?
faq.answer: Trias links Dashel’s name to papers about the King’s envoy’s disappearance. Dashel may know names, places, or orders tied to whoever organized the abduction.
No. Stonefist is hostile to strangers meddling in his business. Trias expects him to resist and advises you to use a weapon or your fists to make him talk.
Confronting Dashel leads to a brawl. Once subdued, he gives you leads on the network behind the diplomat’s abduction and points toward other conspirators within the kingdom.

faq.q: Who is the missing diplomat mentioned in the quest?
faq.answer: Stormwind authorities speak only of an unnamed diplomat who vanished while traveling to Theramore to meet Jaina Proudmoore. The envoy’s identity remains a closely guarded secret at this stage of the investigation.

angles.text: As a rogue, you are at home in Old Town, among informants like Trias and thuggish enforcers like Stonefist.
As a human of Stormwind, you see troubling proof that local street scum are aiding high treason against the kingdom’s leadership.
As an Alliance member, you know that unraveling the conspiracy behind the missing diplomat matters to the Alliance’s stability and to the kingdom at its heart.
